audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose is accurate at EVEN 5.5/10 but the lane-difficulty story is told with generic Kassadin filler instead of Ahri's actual pressure tools.
audit.why: Ahri outranges Null Sphere 970 to 650 with Orb of Deception (7s) and threatens Charm (E) at 975 range on a flat 12s at every rank. Kassadin's difficulty in this lane is entirely 'stay outside 975 until level 16', which the page never states.
audit.corrected: breakdown.early, breakdown.mid, dontsFull[0].d rewritten around the 970/650 range gap and Charm's flat 12s.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes was the generic Kassadin clock line; spikes[0].text claimed 'Ahri hits 3 items of poke pressure fast' at levels 3-5, which is impossible.
audit.why: At levels 3-5 Ahri has three ranks, not three items. The real spikes are: Ahri's level 6 Spirit Rush (140/120/100s, three dashes), Kassadin's Riftwalk rank-up 5s to 2s, and his first item.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text now says 'three ranks'; breakdown.spikes keyed to Ahri's roams, Charm, and level 16.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Charm 'instantly stops movement abilities', so it cancels Riftwalk. Also unstated: Orb of Deception's return hit is TRUE damage, which Null Sphere's magic shield does not absorb; and Ahri's own casting charges Force Pulse.
audit.why: Riot's Charm text explicitly stops movement abilities; Riot's Orb text says true damage on the way back; Null Sphere's shield absorbs magic damage only; Force Pulse charges from spells cast in Kassadin's vicinity. All four are in the kits and none reached the page.
audit.corrected: enemyWin, tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.trading, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d and phases[4].why now carry these.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that holds real cooldowns. Charm is 12s flat, Orb 7s flat, Riftwalk 5/3.5/2.

audit.whatIsWrong: Essence Theft sustain never mentioned; no anti-heal cue.
audit.why: brief.missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal: Ahri heals off every 9 minions and off takedowns, which resets extended trades.
audit.corrected: breakdown.feeding now states the Essence Theft reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: 17 misgendered fields (Ahri called he/his/him) and two copy-paste bleeds where dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Ahri is she/her per champ-gender.js; the bullets promised 'Blink OUT' and 'Stand at half HP' and explained neither.
audit.corrected: All flagged fields rewritten; both bullets given bodies that match their titles.

audit.why: 52.52% over 3016 games; no elo split written.
